title: Patch: quasi-3D cards: a picture's layers stand at depths and tilt with the pointer and the phone, under a glare that follows the light, for every Epic and up
notes: How cards look only: nothing plays differently. A face that is Epic or rarer, or prints full art at any level, draws its picture as four planes by its painter's roles (the background far, the props in the middle, the subject near, what lies over it, its light and its motes nearest); a delivered art file, a Starship in play, a Legacy card, a restyled picture, Immersive, Out of frame and Extended art stay as they were. Such a face tilts toward the pointer up to CARD_TILT_MAX_DEG, its planes shifting by their depth (CARD_DEPTH_STEP_PX), under a white glare that lies opposite the tilt and is blended by area (color-dodge over the art, overlay over the frame), each foil catching it by area and a Radiant frame none (R2725004). It runs in hand and on the board under the card's own pointer or touch, in the hover preview under the window's pointer, in inspect under that and a touch drag, and in the Collection; it follows the phone's orientation once the new device-only setting Tilt with my phone is on; one face tilts at a time and none while the animation queue drains. A Legendary or Mythic face in hand and in inspect lets its subject break the window's top edge (CARD_FRAME_BREAK_PX). Reduced motion, the system's setting and the fx intensity off draw the flat picture with the foil still. R3344000, R3344001.

player.title: Quasi-3D cards
new: Epic, Legendary and Mythic cards, and every full-art card, now have depth: the picture is built from layers, with the background far back and the subject and what floats in front of it nearer.
Move the pointer over one of these cards, in your hand, in the preview, in the Collection or in inspect, and it tilts toward you, its layers sliding past each other.
A glare moves across the card as it tilts, and each foil catches the light in its own way, on the art and on the frame; a Radiant frame keeps its gold.
On a phone, press or drag a card in inspect to tilt it; turn on Tilt with my phone in the settings and the cards tilt as you tilt the phone.
A Legendary or Mythic card's subject may step over the top edge of its picture in your hand and in inspect.
changes: Reduce motion, your system's reduced-motion setting and effects intensity Off show the flat picture with the foil standing still.
A new switch, Tilt with my phone, in the visuals settings; your phone asks once to allow it.
